response.sql: WITH feature_data AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, SUM(traitcount) OVER () as total_traits, COUNT(*) OVER () as record_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), with_margins AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, CAST(traitcount AS REAL) / CAST(total_traits AS REAL) as share, 1.0 / CAST(record_count AS REAL) as avg_share, CAST(traitcount AS REAL) / CAST(total_traits AS REAL) - 1.0 / CAST(record_count AS REAL) as margin FROM feature_data) SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, margin FROM with_margins WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 10
